evidence: Touches `src/bitcoin-cli.cpp` argument handling and help text for `-rpcclienttimeout=0`.
rationale: Clarifies `bitcoin-cli` documentation and aligns implementation for `-rpcclienttimeout=0` with the actual socket wait cap. It replaces an arbitrary 5-year placeholder with `Sock::MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT` and notes that 0 selects the maximum supported timeout (~24 days).
